usedFor: Health and wellness practices use “New Client” in EasyPractice to start a follow-up whenever a client is added.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in EasyPractice, then “Add Or Update Contact In List” in EmailOctopus
bestTemplate.why: Each new client lands on an email list without anyone typing them in.

watchOut: “New Client” is pushed when a client is created, but anything sent to clients waits in Needs you for approval.
